paperTitle: Conceptual Element Extractor from Scientific Papers
centralContribution: This work introduces CancerSP, a serious game designed to enhance decision-making and planning skills in prostate cancer management by replicating real-world symptoms, treatment patterns, and care pathways. The game allows players, in the role of medical professionals, to concurrently manage multiple prostate cancer patients, prioritizing care, making diagnoses through medical tests, and applying appropriate treatments, with the ultimate goal of saving patients' lives.

content.description: This work introduces CancerSP, a serious game designed to enhance decision-making and planning skills in prostate cancer management by replicating real-world symptoms, treatment patterns, and care pathways. The game allows players, in the role of medical professionals, to concurrently manage multiple prostate cancer patients, prioritizing care, making diagnoses through medical tests, and applying appropriate treatments, with the ultimate goal of saving patients' lives.

content.description: CancerSP is a serious game designed to improve medical professionals' decision-making and planning skills in prostate cancer management. Players handle multiple patient cases simultaneously, performing diagnoses via medical tests and applying appropriate treatments to save lives, mimicking real-world clinical scenarios.

units.whyThisUnit: Provides a concise, objective summary of the paper's content and purpose.
